body.x: Grillbots(www.grillbots.com) unveiled 'Automatic Grill Cleaning Robot' at '2014 International CES', the biggest ITappliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
Company explained "Grillbot is the easy-to-use, fun to watch, fully automated device that easily cleans with just the push of a button"

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500~3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
